name: trinet-ai-smart-assist
description: Librarian: a codebase index that makes GitHub Copilot (and other AI agents) use fewer tokens and fewer turns — and gets smarter as you use it.

enumDescriptions: Use the GitHub Copilot subscription already signed in to VS Code (no API key).
Call Anthropic directly — key set with "Librarian: Set Anthropic API Key".
Never call a model; build free skeletons and graph only.
trishAI.aiProvider.description: Model used to write per-file summaries. Summaries are cached and only regenerated when a file's API changes.

trishAI.copilotModel.markdownDescription: Exact Copilot model id used for background summaries. **Empty means no summaries**: Librarian never picks a model for you. Choose it with **Librarian: Open Setup**.

trishAI.anthropicApiKey.deprecationMessage: Stored in plain text. Use the "Librarian: Set Anthropic API Key" command (secure storage) instead.
trishAI.anthropicApiKey.markdownDescription: Deprecated — migrated to secure storage automatically.

enumDescriptions: Regenerate a summary only when the file's exported API changes (fewest AI calls).
Regenerate whenever the file content changes (freshest, more calls).
trishAI.contextRefreshPolicy.description: When cached AI summaries are considered out of date.

trishAI.autoUpdateSkeletons.description: Re-extract the skeleton of a file when you save it (free, no AI).

trishAI.autoIndexOnStartup.description: Build/refresh skeletons for the whole workspace in the background on startup (free, no AI).

trishAI.promptTokenBudget.description: Maximum size of a context pack (approximate tokens).

trishAI.maxFileSizeKB.description: Files larger than this get a skeleton but no AI summary.

enumDescriptions: Write to .trishAI/local (git-ignored overlay). Use when CI maintains the shared index.
Write to .trishAI/shared (committed). Use if you maintain the index by hand without CI.
trishAI.writeLayer.description: Which index layer this machine writes to.

trishAI.learning.enabled.description: Remember which files you change after asking Librarian, to rank them higher for similar tasks.

trishAI.costPerMillionTokens.markdownDescription: Optional input price (USD per 1M tokens) to show an indicative cost in **Librarian: Estimate Token Savings**. 0 hides it.

chatParticipants.name: librarian
chatParticipants.description: Answer using the pre-built codebase index (fewer tokens than attaching files)

commands.name: context
commands.description: Build the context pack only — no model call

commands.name: related
commands.description: Imports, importers and co-changed files for a path

commands.name: status
commands.description: Index coverage, freshness and estimated savings

languageModelTools.name: librarian_findRelevantFiles
languageModelTools.userDescription: Find the files relevant to a task using the codebase index.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Call this FIRST for any coding task in this repository, before reading source files. Given a natural-language task, returns the most relevant files with their exported signatures and short summaries (from a pre-built index), ranked using text match, the import graph and files changed in similar past tasks. Much cheaper than reading files.

task.description: The task, in the user's words plus any identifiers you know.

languageModelTools.name: librarian_getSkeleton
languageModelTools.userDescription: Show a file's exported API and summary without reading it.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns the exported API (signatures) and summary of one or more files from the index without reading the full source. Use instead of reading a file when you only need to know what it exports or how to call it.

languageModelTools.name: librarian_getRelatedFiles
languageModelTools.userDescription: Show imports, importers and co-changed files.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Shows which files a file imports, which files import it, and which files were usually changed together with it in past tasks. Use before changing a file's exports or when looking for the call sites of a module.

scripts.compile: pnpm run check-types && pnpm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: pnpm run check-types && pnpm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
